visibility_states.meaning: Not rendered at all (used for secrets/hidden content).
Just unlocked; shows a highlight badge until clicked.

condition_grammar.description: Conditions are simple boolean expressions evaluated against game state.

inventory_ui.layout: Collapsible category groups (Weapons, Armor, Potions, Materials, Exotic, Quest, Currency).
inventory_ui.per_group: Each group is an expand/retract dropdown; collapsed by default once it has many items.
inventory_ui.item_row: icon-less text row: name (rarity-colored), qty, additive stat summary, actions.
inventory_ui.additive_note: Stat summary panel at top shows total stats granted by everything held.
